- **Project Name**:
- **Repository URL**: `https://github.com/...`

- **Open-Source License**:
- **Primary Language**:

---

## ✅ Contributor Checklist

Please confirm each item before submitting your Pull Request:

- [ ] **Genuinely Open Source**: The source code is publicly accessible in a public Git repository.
- [ ] **Accepted License**: The project carries an official OSI or FSF recognized open-source license (e.g. MIT, Apache-2.0, GPL-3.0).
- [ ] **macOS Compatibility**: The project runs on macOS (Apple Silicon or Intel) as a GUI app, menubar tool, or CLI utility.
- [ ] **Icon Added**: A 1:1 square SVG (preferred) or 256x256 PNG is committed to `icons/project-icons/<id>.svg`.
- [ ] **No Duplicates**: Checked that neither the project name nor repository URL already exists in `data/projects.yml`.
- [ ] **Validation Script**: Ran `python3 scripts/validate-projects.py` locally and verified that all checks passed.
- [ ] **README Regenerated**: Ran `python3 scripts/generate-readme.py` locally to synchronize `README.md`.

---

## 🔍 Maintainer Review (For Maintainers)
- [ ] Upstream repository license file inspected and verified.
- [ ] Project builds/runs on macOS or releases official macOS binaries.
- [ ] Automated CI workflow passes.
